name: Variant Hunt
description: After any vulnerability or bug is confirmed, sweep the entire codebase for every other instance of the same pattern with ripgrep and custom Semgrep rules so the whole class is fixed, not one case. Use right after finding or fixing a security issue, when checking a fix is complete, or to prove a past pattern is eradicated. Defensive only.
verification_requirements: tools and patterns used are named so the sweep is reproducible
re-run of the rule returns zero matches after fixes, or every remaining instance is justified
